title: Correct unsupported and compiler-authored source claims
description:
Repair the source-authority defects and define the standing policy for editorial
correction and supplemental material.

Root cause: the compiler may author a value and attach SRD provenance to it, and
the coverage gates (source->output only) cannot see it.

*** STARTING WEALTH — DECIDED, NOT OPEN ***
Remove table:starting-wealth-by-class from the SRD pack. It is hardcoded PHB
content produced by emit.ts startingWealthTable() (its comment claims
"Source-backed p. 38"); no starting-wealth text exists anywhere in SRD 5.1, yet
it carries source "SRD 5.1 p. 38" and the full CC-BY-4.0 SRD attribution block.
Required behavior:
  * remove the table from the SRD pack;
  * disable the starting-wealth character-creation path when only the SRD pack is
    active (reconcile srdStartingWealth.ts and finalizeCharacter.ts in the same
    change);
  * continue supporting the source-backed class STARTING-EQUIPMENT choices, which
    are genuinely in the SRD;
  * permit starting wealth only when a separately identified, appropriately
    licensed campaign supplement provides it.
REJECTED: "re-homing" the existing PHB table by relabeling it supplemental. The
label is not the problem — its source and redistribution rights are. An original
Eshyra house-rule table may eventually be supplied through the campaign-rule
system (eshyra-jhpt), but it must not reproduce the unsupported PHB table under a
new name.

Remaining required membership:
2. Correct Animal Friendship handling WITHOUT claiming a text-layer-only
   omission. spell:animal-friendship carries upcast.sourceCorrection with id
   "dnd5e-srd-5.1:animal-friendship:higher-slot:text-layer-omission" over the
   corrupted phrase "...you can affect one additional beast t level above 1st."
   The correction must rest on a pinned authoritative source or be represented as
   an explicit unresolved source defect.
3. Correct the Bag of Beans successful-save outcome, coordinated with 19.4.5.
4. Remove the stale loreweaver-* manifest claim: exactly one occurrence,
   "loreweaver-0m9.5", in
   packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/manifest.json.
5. Distinguish composed sourceText, synthesized choice labels, and synthesized
   table headers from source quotations (spellPreparation sourceText; acolyte
   choices[].sourceText; table:scrying "Basis"/"Circumstance" headers).

Closes findings: fable:F1, fable:F5, fable:F7, sol:CAP-008, sol:CAP-009,
opus:F-19, opus:F-20.
design:
Independent confirmation (2026-07-24 audit): the animal-friendship
sourceCorrection hash was verified to MATCH the extracted text — the correction is
internally consistent. The defect is the CLAIM about why the text differs (a
"text-layer omission"), not a hash mismatch. Do NOT "fix" this by re-running the
extractor.
acceptance_criteria:
- table:starting-wealth-by-class no longer exists in the SRD pack, and no relabeled copy of it exists anywhere in the repo.
- SRD-only character creation completes with the starting-wealth path disabled; source-backed starting-equipment choices still work.
- No output carries SRD provenance or CC attribution for unsupported content.
- Any source correction rests on a pinned authoritative source, or remains an explicit unresolved source defect — never a silent editorial repair.
- Negative regression test: a compiler-authored value cannot acquire the SRD license/provenance block by default.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
